turns.question: By how many euros did our average order grow from August to September 2026?
turns.answer: Average order value (EUR) was 92.25 EUR in August 2026 (1-31 August) and 114.39 EUR in September 2026 (1-30 September); the semantic layer has no metric for the month-over-month change in average order value, so I give the two monthly figures rather than computing the difference myself. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
